title: Helios Console — Credentials
description: Secrets tier of the Helios Console managed configuration. Preference domain: com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.credentials — deploy as its own Jamf Pro 'Application & Custom Settings' configuration profile, scoped to ALL managed Macs running Helios (per variant: each credentials variant goes to every Helios Mac that should use that credential set). This domain holds ONLY secrets so they can be rotated independently of the non-secret core/features/ui profiles — rotating a leaked or expiring secret means editing and re-pushing this one small profile without touching, re-testing, or re-scoping any other Helios profile. SECURITY WARNING: managed-preference plists are written world-readable to /Library/Managed Preferences/com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.credentials.plist — any local user or process on the Mac can read these values off disk. Scope tightly, use least-privilege API roles, and rotate immediately on any suspected exposure. PAIRED SCOPING RULE (with com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.access): a write-capable variant of this credentials profile (one whose Jamf Pro client secret belongs to an API role with write/destructive permissions) and the access profile granting role=Admin MUST be scoped to the same Macs — never deliver write-capable credentials to a Mac without the matching Admin access profile, and never grant role=Admin to Macs carrying only read-only credentials. No secret has a pre-filled default; replace every REPLACE-WITH-… placeholder with the real value in Jamf before deployment and never commit real values to source control.

configurationVersion.description: Schema version for compatibility checking (informational — the loader logs it, nothing else reads it)

jamfProClientSecret.title: Jamf Pro Master API Client Secret
jamfProClientSecret.description: OAuth client_secret for the master Jamf Pro API client (pairs with jamfPro.masterClientID delivered in com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.core). REQUIRED — Helios cannot authenticate to Jamf Pro without it. No default is provided: enter the real value directly in Jamf, replacing REPLACE-WITH-jamf-pro-client-secret. Sensitive — the managed-pref plist is world-readable on disk; scope the API Role tightly and rotate if exposed.

abmPrivateKey.title: Apple Business Manager Private Key (PEM)
abmPrivateKey.description: PEM-encoded ES256 private key for ABM JWT signing (pairs with appleBusinessManager.clientID and keyID delivered in com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.core). Optional — omit this key entirely if the ABM integration is not used. Paste the full PEM string including the BEGIN/END PRIVATE KEY lines, replacing REPLACE-WITH-abm-private-key-pem. Sensitive — the managed-pref plist is world-readable on disk; scope tightly and rotate if exposed.

jamfProtectPassword.title: Jamf Protect API Password (Client Secret)
jamfProtectPassword.description: The Jamf Protect API client's password/secret (the API authenticates with client_id + password; the client_id is delivered in com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.core). Optional two-tier behavior: if delivered here, this value is used and the in-app password field locks; if omitted, the app falls back to in-app entry, storing the value in the Keychain item com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.protect.password. No default is provided: enter the real value directly in Jamf, replacing REPLACE-WITH-jamf-protect-password. Sensitive — the managed-pref plist is world-readable on disk; scope this profile tightly.
